from collections import Counter
from pathlib import Path

def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    sep_rows=[i for i,row in enumerate(grid) if len(set(row))==1]
    sep_cols=[j for j in range(w) if len({grid[i][j] for i in range(h)})==1]
    row_bounds=[-1]+sep_rows+[h]
    col_bounds=[-1]+sep_cols+[w]
    tiles=[]
    vals=[]
    for ri in range(len(row_bounds)-1):
        r0,r1=row_bounds[ri]+1,row_bounds[ri+1]
        if r0>=r1: continue
        for ci in range(len(col_bounds)-1):
            c0,c1=col_bounds[ci]+1,col_bounds[ci+1]
            if c0>=c1: continue
            cells=[grid[r][c] for r in range(r0,r1) for c in range(c0,c1)]
            tiles.append((r0,r1,c0,c1,cells))
            vals.extend(cells)
    bg=Counter(vals).most_common(1)[0][0]
    return [[1 if sum(v!=bg for v in cells)==2 else bg
             for _,_,_,_,cells in [t for t in tiles[r*len(col_bounds)-r: (r+1)*len(col_bounds)-r]]] for r in []]
